claims.claim: Accuracy vs S will be fit at least as well by a smooth monotone spline as by a piecewise regime model (piecewise AIC advantage < 10) on at least one of the two task families
The unlimited shared-log baseline will match or exceed the best bounded-S configuration in accuracy on at least one task family
The random-salience control will produce accuracy-vs-S curves statistically indistinguishable from self-assessed salience curves at most S values
Accuracy at S=8 or S=16 will exceed accuracy at S=1 on average across task families and broadcast frequencies.
The best bounded configuration will achieve higher measured accuracy than the unlimited-log baseline.
The piecewise/regime model will fail to beat the smooth monotone fit by AIC >= 10 on both task families.
Piecewise/regime model beats smooth monotone spline by AIC >= 10 on both task families
Best bounded-S configuration outperforms the unlimited shared-log baseline
Accuracy rises from near single-agent at S=1 to substantially higher by S>=8 on both families
